facts.fact: Ecofin Agency reports Gabonese fleet-management startup POZI announced on 3 October 2025 a EUR 650,000 funding round led by Saviu Ventures with Emsy Capital and Chazai Wamba taking part.

GAB.note: No public startup law, label or fund stated; the deal is a private investor round.
No hub, incubator or park stated.
